encoding: Little endian. Header, ordered tick records, actual 512-byte successor result, WORLD_EVENTS entries, CRC32 of all preceding bytes. World key generation is its one-based log index; KEY_FLAGS bits 0/1/2 encode view/tier/buffer, remaining bits zero. ANCHOR_MASK identifies retained candidate handles. Registration CRC32 covers the exact 65 fixture bytes copied into the completed backbuffer (presentation contract sceneOffsets). The tick record references the log by generation and source tick; its duplicated timestamp was removed. SERVICE_PHASE_MASKS is two epochs of input/audio/display u16 masks, each bit a measured pre-release start bin. SERVICE_ORDER_MASKS is one u8 per epoch; bits 0-5 identify completed three-service permutations. Presentation high-water/drop/request/cancel/masks are actual owner observations. Remaining reserved fields zero. The maximum is unchanged at 327172 bytes; every world is retained, overflow rejects, no truncation. The 2000-event limit is a diagnostic allocation bound, not a production rate/capacity.
observationProtocol: Two epochs separated by returning storage; sixteen independently released 100-tick cohorts per epoch. First post-storage tick uses the restart release. Other cohorts start at measured frame offsets; acquisition pauses between cohorts are excluded from active-tick claims and rolling windows.
thresholdPolicy: Nominal 10ms ratio only; raw counts and unresolved SI uncertainty retained. No 530000-clock budget, per-stage budget, service limit or maximum world age is introduced. Report 20Hz floor over complete one-second nominal cohorts; no physical acceptance from emulator timing.
irqProtocol: Two epoch summaries: count u16, total CIA counts u32, maximum u16. Only declared cohorts are enabled. Interval is between coherent CIA reads after register preservation and before restoration; includes part of probes, excludes hardware entry and tails. Not full interrupt cost or entry latency. Bounded-read, count, total and duration overflow invalidate acquisition.
